{{Quote|The whole planet's covered in snow from pole to pole.|[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Fi Skirata|Fi]]|<ref name="RC" />}}
'''Fest''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Fest system/Legends|Fest system]]. It was a frozen and densely populated world with few wilderness areas beyond several steep-ridged [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges and deep valleys.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|We visited the industrial plants on Fest, once. The toxic zones were much like this; so many workers were sick.|Vector Hyllus, upon visiting the ruins of the Taris ChemWorks factory|<ref name="ClimbingHigh">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Climbing High}}</ref>}}
Fest was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Fest system/Legends|Fest system]], in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] L-5.<ref name="EAOC" /> Fest was covered in [[Water/Legends|ice]] with mountains and valleys.<ref name="RS I" /> Many urban zones exist with dedicated spaceports, factories and densely packed population centers.

==History==
While the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] kept the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in suspense, a climbing tournament was held and promised a reward for the person who climbed the highest mountain of Fest the quickest.<ref name="ClimbingHigh" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] set up a research center on Fest, developing the [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] supermetal. It was [[Raid on Fest|raided]] and destroyed by [[Omega Squad]] ten [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the war.<ref name="RC" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was ravaged both by a [[civil war]] among its inhabitants and a war against [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. The Festians were rebellious to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and knew that it was about to attack Mantooine, but the distrust for each other, coupled with a lack of communications facilities, prevented them from giving warning. Ultimately, however, the two planets found common cause in their conflict with the Empire, and their combined resistance forces formed the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]].<ref name="rso" />

[[File:Fest-DarkForces.png|thumb|left|Fest's rocky landscape]]
Fest housed an [[Weapons Research Facility|Imperial base]] where phrik alloys were tested, in order to be used for the strong lightweight armor of the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]], an Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Dark Trooper Project|development program]]. During his investigation on the project, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]], working in favor of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Mission to Fest (Galactic Civil War)|infiltrated]] the base. The discovery of such a sample led Kyle and his partner [[Jan Ors]] to the [[Gromas 16|Blood Moon]] of [[Gromas/Legends|Gromas]].<ref name="Dark Forces" />

The Weapons Research Facility was under the administration of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]]. [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel commandos]] [[Escape from Fest|stole]] [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transport]] walkers from the facility, and their escape was covered by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], an elite Rebel Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit under the command of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. After the commandos escaped, the Rogues destroyed the facility<ref name="RS I" />

From [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the planet became part of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] until the death of [[Ardus Kaine]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Fest first appeared in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''.
